description: Upload a video file from this machine (WebM, MP4, or QuickTime .mov) to the user's Clipy library and return its share link and agent-context link. Processing (transcript, summary, key moments) starts automatically; call wait_for_artifacts next if you need them. Counts toward the user's recording allowance. Needs a key with ingest.

access.description: Who can open the link. Omit for the account default.

name.description: Title. Defaults to the file name.

path.description: Absolute path of the video file.

type.description: What the video is: bug, feature, demo, walkthrough, feedback, discussion or other.

name: upload_video
